import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_25/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_25/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_25/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_25/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_25/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_25/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_25/training_6.csv",
]

# Read all source files into dataframes with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# All source tables have the same schema and match the target schema except column order:
# Target schema order: ['Name', 'Rank', 'Team', 'Position', 'Played', 'SnapsPlayed', 'SnapsPerGame',
# 'SnapsPlayedPercentage', 'RushSnapPercentage', 'TargetSnapPercentage', 'TouchSnapPercentage',
# 'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage', 'FantasyPoints', 'FantasyPointSnapPercentage']

# Source tables have schema: ['Rank', 'Name', 'Team', 'Position', 'Played', 'SnapsPlayed', 'SnapsPerGame',
# 'SnapsPlayedPercentage', 'RushSnapPercentage', 'TargetSnapPercentage', 'TouchSnapPercentage',
# 'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage', 'FantasyPoints', 'FantasyPointSnapPercentage']

# We need to reorder columns to match target schema and ensure correct dtypes.

# Concatenate all source dataframes (UNION)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns to target schema order
target_columns = [
    'Name', 'Rank', 'Team', 'Position', 'Played', 'SnapsPlayed', 'SnapsPerGame',
    'SnapsPlayedPercentage', 'RushSnapPercentage', 'TargetSnapPercentage', 'TouchSnapPercentage',
    'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage', 'FantasyPoints', 'FantasyPointSnapPercentage'
]

df_all = df_all[target_columns]

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema:
# 'Name': string
df_all['Name'] = df_all['Name'].astype(str)

# 'Rank': integer
df_all['Rank'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['Rank'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# 'Team': string
df_all['Team'] = df_all['Team'].astype(str)

# 'Position': string
df_all['Position'] = df_all['Position'].astype(str)

# 'Played': integer
df_all['Played'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['Played'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# 'SnapsPlayed': integer
df_all['SnapsPlayed'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['SnapsPlayed'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# 'SnapsPerGame': float
df_all['SnapsPerGame'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['SnapsPerGame'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'SnapsPlayedPercentage': float
df_all['SnapsPlayedPercentage'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['SnapsPlayedPercentage'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'RushSnapPercentage': float
df_all['RushSnapPercentage'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['RushSnapPercentage'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'TargetSnapPercentage': float
df_all['TargetSnapPercentage'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['TargetSnapPercentage'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'TouchSnapPercentage': float
df_all['TouchSnapPercentage'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['TouchSnapPercentage'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage': float
df_all['IntendedTouchSnapPercentage'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['IntendedTouchSnapPercentage'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'FantasyPoints': float
df_all['FantasyPoints'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['FantasyPoints'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'FantasyPointSnapPercentage': float
df_all['FantasyPointSnapPercentage'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['FantasyPointSnapPercentage'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Save the final dataframe to the target path
df_all.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
